title: A qokeol/okeol whole marks a transformation stage rather than an action or material
summary: Use the exact qokeol/okeol pair census to distinguish a shared stage/state label from an action operator or nominal material head; the prior q-versus-base process/preparation split failed, so this is a different conditional prediction.

design.mechanism: The complete whole contributes a transformation-stage or quality-state value (for example a heat/middle-stage state) while remaining neutral about the actor, action, and material.
design.unit: Complete qokeol/okeol occurrences with independently coded stage/quality state, action-host status, material-head status, and matched local fields.
design.contrast: The stage/state model versus action-operator and nominal-material models, using qokeol/okeol pair-matched contexts and held fields where the same stage can occur with different action or material neighbors.
design.prediction: A stage/state reading predicts a stable stage/quality relation across both forms and across process/material and preparation contexts, without requiring a fixed action or material. The action rival predicts action-host dependence; the material rival predicts noun-head attachment.
design.falsifier: If independently bound held cases show no stage/quality association after form, host, page, and position controls, while action or material role is the only stable contrast, this stage hypothesis fails. The prior failed q/base split alone is not its falsifier.
design.scope: Cached reader-exact GDT753 occurrences only; no new pages or component exports. Independent stage, action, and material endpoints are availability_unknown.
design.related: Related to GDT753 and IDEA000036 process-state framing, but distinct from the failed q-versus-base process/preparation split: the target is a shared stage/state role across both forms, not a q-conditioned action/material alternation.
design.countermodel: A renderer can attach a generic heat/middle label to every occurrence, or host and position can jointly create an apparent stage association without the whole encoding a state.

source_evidence.quote:
Die alte Aufteilung hält nicht. Im zugelassenen Cache gibt es 34
reader-exakte `qokeol`- und 41 reader-exakte `okeol`-Vorkommen auf zusammen 40
Seiten. Von ihren target-zentrierten Feldern sind 15 beziehungsweise 19
vollständig begrenzt.

| Form | vollständige Felder | Prozess/Stoff + Mittelstufe | Zubereitung |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `qokeol` | 15 | 3 auf 2 Seiten | 6 auf 6 Seiten |
| `okeol` | 19 | 4 auf 4 Seiten | 8 auf 8 Seiten |

der Basis-minus-q-Unterschied für Zubereitung ist `0.021053`. Das ist
praktisch dieselbe Verteilung, nicht die behauptete Gegenüberstellung. Der
gerichtete Test scheitert. Dasselbe gilt für alle fünf frequenzähnlichen
